config.label: Passphrase used to encrypt the local state file (JWT / API key / session key) at rest
config.description: Passphrase used to encrypt the local state file (JWT / API key / session key) at rest. Pick any string. The harness endpoint, thirdweb client, origin and login chain are baked into the package — this is the only required input.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Directory for the encrypted local state file. Defaults to %APPDATA%/stablecoinx-mcp (Windows) or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/stablecoinx-mcp.
